import io
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DATA = """year,5 km band outside,inside the park
2001,1919.4,1057.4
2002,1115.8,715.64
2003,1921.1,1595.4
2004,1518.6,846.25
2005,1326.1,1129.7
2006,1459.6,1118.9
2007,2513.9,1342.3
2008,3404.3,968.36
2009,4196,2421.9
2010,4404.2,2992.5
2011,2915.7,719.67
2012,3965.7,1196
2013,2287,563.28
2014,5259.5,2738.4
2015,2281.4,735.87
2016,4129.6,1633.8
2017,3369.7,975.97
2018,4347.9,1479.1
2019,2454.6,1092.2
2020,3026,1278.8
2021,3900.5,1080.8
2022,4276.7,752.54
2023,4302.9,776.62
2024,4591,1460.6
"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(DATA))

def plot_loss(df):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.2, 3.4))
    ax.plot(df.year, df["inside the park"], color="#b2182b", lw=2, marker="o", ms=3,
            label="inside the park")
    ax.plot(df.year, df["5 km band outside"], color="#878787", lw=1.5, ls="--",
            label="5 km band outside")
    ax.set_ylabel("Forest cleared (ha per year)")
    ax.set_title("Forest clearing inside Gunung Leuser National Park", loc="left", fontsize=10)
    ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8)
    return fig

plot_loss(df)
plt.show()

import io
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DATA = """year,bare_or_turbid_near_rivers_ha
2019,2909
2020,3310.7
2021,3783
2022,3621.9
2023,3541
2024,3959.6
new since 2019 (map),395.18
"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(DATA))

def plot_river(df):
    d = df[pd.to_numeric(df.year, errors="coerce").notna()]      # drop the summary row
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.8, 3.2))
    ax.bar(d.year.astype(str), d.bare_or_turbid_near_rivers_ha, color="#a6611a")
    ax.set_ylabel("Bare ground or turbid water\nwithin 1 km of rivers (ha)")
    ax.set_title("Riverside bare ground, Merangin (dry season)", loc="left", fontsize=10)
    return fig

plot_river(df)
plt.show()
